items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: John lives in the San Diego area and he can be seen performing with his friend, clarinetist Bobby Gordon.

ctx.x: Because I’ve done, for about ten years my late wife and I put on jazz things right at a place called Little Bavaria. And there, we just took over the place and hired the musicians. Most of them were like Nick Fatool, Eddie Miller and Abe Most, and Abe © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

Lincoln the trombone player, and Bobby Gordon. All good jazz players, and that went on once a month for about ten years. And I think as far as — of course I was the leader, so I got to do what I picked. But working with Matty Matlock, who did a lot of recordings, and he used me on, those are the things that I’m glad I did because I can listen to those — they’re not like the big organized bands, it’s just a recording date, you do that and you don’t play that, but Matty was a wonderful writer, arranger, a good…
